transport: Keep panda attractions and old-city strolling on separate half-days when possible.
Metro works well across core districts, but buffer extra time for holiday crowding.
Use one food-heavy district per meal window instead of zig-zagging across the city.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Swap parks and riverside walking for museums, covered markets, tea houses, or shopping complexes.
Use indoor food halls or cultural venues as flexible afternoon anchors.

leisure.pace_note: Chengdu works best with a relaxed rhythm and room for tea, snacks, and neighborhood wandering.

family.pace_note: Use one headline family stop plus one nearby low-effort backup.

food.pace_note: Group meals by district and keep enough buffer for queues and snack stops.

theme.pace_note: Build around one strong narrative such as Three Kingdoms, old Chengdu, or creative districts.

suggestions: Good day for panda-related outdoor sections and historic walking streets.
